title: Happy Hangar Flights
specs: Flight in a Super Stearman - 400+ HP open cockpit biplane
Watch incredible sunsets as you cruise down the beach
Cafe with views of airplanes taking off and landing
Flight bookings best arranged in advance by appointment, but walkups are welcome
blurb: Guests can take flights in a Super Stearman biplane with an expert pilot, experiencing open cockpit flying and beach views including sunsets. The cafe offers breakfast and lunch with views of airplanes taking off and landing. The location is family friendly and situated at Tampa North Flight Center airport.
